findings.text: On the Purchased Together page, clicking the Live Retaker variant button three times (over ~25 s, after a 3 s wait) did nothing: the price stayed R7 905,00 and Self Study stayed highlighted. After a reload plus a 5 s wait the same click worked. A customer would buy the wrong variant or give up. Possibly the KI066 hydration issue but it persisted well past hydration time.
On the Deep Energy Clearing page, Add to Cart clicked right after a variant click gave no cart item; /checkout bounced to an empty /cart. Same family as KI066 (no feedback).
